app.name: COptimizer
rights.limited.hint: Without Administrator rights some folders can't be read.
rights.demo.hint: A simulated PC: nothing on this computer is read.
simulate.pill.hint: Simulation mode: cleanups only show what they would do.
locked.title: This page needs a new link
locked.body: Each link works only once. Start COptimizer again, or type L and press Enter in its window to get a new link.
stopped.title: COptimizer has stopped
error.title: Something went wrong
quit.confirm: Stop COptimizer? A running scan will be cancelled.
drives.title: Drives
drive.name: {label} ({letter})
scan.title: Scan
scan.empty: Start with a scan of C: to see where the space goes. Scanning only reads; it changes nothing.
scan.hint.unaccounted: Space in use that no folder explains, usually restore points or file-system data.
scan.hint.denied: Folders that couldn't be read count as empty. With Administrator rights COptimizer can measure them.
scan.reclaimable: Safe to clean: {safe} · With trade-offs: {moderate} · Your decision: {manual}
findings.noScan: Run a scan first: the findings come from its results.
findings.readOnly: Cleanups aren't available in this session. Each finding says how to reclaim its space yourself.
findings.cleanups: Some findings can be cleaned from here. Every cleanup starts with a preview of exactly what it will delete, and nothing happens until you confirm. The other findings say how to reclaim their space yourself.
findings.details: How to reclaim it, and where ({count})
findings.unreadable: couldn't be read without Administrator rights
action.delete.title: Clean up: {name}
action.delete.summary: Deletes {files} ({bytes}). They are deleted for good, not moved to the Recycle Bin.
action.recycle-bin.title: Empty the Recycle Bin
action.recycle-bin.summary: Empties your Recycle Bin on {drive}, with {items} ({bytes}). Deleted items can't be restored afterwards. Other accounts' Recycle Bins stay as they are.
action.component-cleanup.title: Clean up the component store
action.component-cleanup.summary: Runs Windows' own cleanup of the component store: DISM removes the components that updates replaced. Installed updates can still be uninstalled afterwards. Only DISM knows how much this frees; COptimizer measures it when DISM is done.
action.delivery-optimization.title: Delete Delivery Optimization files
action.delivery-optimization.summary: Asks Windows' Delivery Optimization service to delete the update files it keeps to share with other PCs, about {bytes}. Windows downloads them again if it needs them.
cleanup.preparing: Working out what this cleanup would do. Nothing is changed.
cleanup.minAge: Files and folders changed in the last {hours} hours are left alone: programs may still be using them.
cleanup.long: This takes several minutes and can't be stopped once it has started. Keep COptimizer open until it finishes.
cleanup.simulate: Simulation mode is on: nothing will be deleted or changed. You'll see what would have happened.
cleanup.blocked.needs-admin: This cleanup needs Administrator rights. Start COptimizer by double-clicking it and accept the Windows prompt.
cleanup.blocked.nothing: There's nothing to clean right now.
cleanup.left.own-tool: needs its own tool: see how to reclaim it
cleanup.loc.kept: {count} left alone: recent, links, or part of another finding
cleanup.reason.link: refused: it leads to another place
cleanup.queued: Waiting for another cleanup to finish…
cleanup.cantStop: This can't be stopped safely once it has started.
cleanup.result.succeeded: Done: {freed} more free space. {files} deleted ({bytes}); the preview expected {estimate}.
cleanup.result.succeeded.recycle: Done: the Recycle Bin is empty, and there is {freed} more free space.
cleanup.result.partial: Done, with exceptions: {freed} more free space. {files} deleted. Not deleted, because in use or not allowed: {skipped}.
cleanup.result.cancelled: Stopped. {files} ({bytes}) had been deleted by then.
cleanup.result.simulated: Simulation finished: {files} ({bytes}) would have been deleted. Nothing was changed.
cleanup.result.simulated.recycle: Simulation finished: the Recycle Bin would have been emptied ({bytes}). Nothing was changed.
cleanup.result.simulated.tool: Simulation finished: COptimizer would have run the command shown before. Nothing was changed.
cleanup.restart: Restart Windows to finish the cleanup.
cleanup.scanAgain: Scan C: again to see the new size of the component store.
cleanup.measured: Free space is measured on the drive, so other programs writing at the same time can change it.
activity.simulate.hint: With simulation mode on, every cleanup only shows what it would do. Nothing is deleted or changed.
activity.noCleanups: Cleanups aren't available in this session.
activity.jobs.none: No cleanups yet. Start one from a finding on the Findings page.
system.title: What Windows reports
system.reserved.on: On: Windows keeps about 7 GB aside for updates
system.componentStore.hint: DISM can analyze it. It only reads, and takes a few minutes.
system.componentStore.result: {actual} in use; {reclaimable} of it could be cleaned up. Cleanup recommended: {recommended}.
explorer.noScan: Run a scan first: the explorer shows its results.
explorer.col.name: Name
explorer.largest.none: None of the largest files found by the scan is in this folder.
explorer.types: File types on the whole scan
